name: Jennifer Edge
bio: Hello Everybody! I love meeting new folks and hearing your tattoo ideas! You can find me at mainlinetattoo.com or catch me by coming to the shop! I'm a big fandom girlie who can do whatever you're looking for in my style! I'm a huge book reader and even have a book themed tattoo convention called Literary Ink! You can check out and keep up with my shenanigans on my IG
